title: The Fork in Probability Where All Roads Were Taken

features.name: the divergent threshold
features.desc-on-touch: You see the place where the archive chose every path at once. The roads do not branch—they bloom outward in all directions simultaneously, and you are standing at their root.

features.name: the probability stones
features.desc-on-touch: Each stone holds a timeline that was not taken. The corruption has filed them all as this moment simultaneously.

features.name: the fork itself
features.desc-on-touch: A structure of pale wood, old, worn smooth by hands that never decided between them. It is the simplest form of choice, rendered at scale.

features.name: the all-choice ledger
features.desc-on-touch: A filecard stands here listing every decision that was made. The ink is still wet, though the card is ancient.

features.name: the moment before knowing
features.desc-on-touch: Here the archive held its breath before the split became visible. Time pooled like water, and the corruption learned to live in the pause.

inscription: every path was taken; you are the one path that is taking the others
